name: Future Tools
requirements: AI tools only — Matt Wolfe's curated AI tools database; submissions are personally reviewed ('Submit it below and Matt will review it').
No account required — a single public form at /submit-a-tool.
CAPTCHA must be solved to submit (a 'Loading CAPTCHA...' widget sits above the submit button).
preparation: Tool name, tool URL, short description.

Category from their fixed list (Chat, Generative Art, Generative Video, Generative Code, Text-To-Speech, Search Engines, Productivity, Marketing, Design, Writing, Music, Research, Education, Finance, Healthcare, Legal, Sales, Customer Support, Other).
Pricing model selection: Free / Freemium / Paid / Open Source.
workflow: Fill Your Name, Tool Name, Tool URL, Short Description, Category, Pricing, Your Email.
Optionally tick the Future Tools newsletter opt-in (optional checkbox).
Solve the CAPTCHA and hit Submit Tool.
Wait for manual review — Matt Wolfe curates the database personally.
watchFor: CAPTCHA gate blocks pure-API submission — needs a browser.
It's a one-person editorial review — no published SLA; curation is selective, not a guaranteed listing.
Newsletter opt-in is a checkbox beside submit — optional, verify its state before sending.
No badge, account, or payment requirement — genuinely free.
countsAsLive: The tool appears under futuretools.io/tools (and 'Newly Added Tools') with a listing card linking to the tool URL.
unknowns: Whether submitters are notified on acceptance.
